Title: Azure Site Recovery available in Korea

Body.Content:
Azure Site Recovery is now available in the Korea Central and Korea South Azure regions.

With this expansion, customers in these regions can enjoy the reliability and performance levels set in the Azure Site Recovery SLA.

To learn more about Azure Site Recovery, see Getting started with Azure Site Recovery. For more information about the regional availability of the service, visit the Azure regions page.
